summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of TallyDekho app - all 16 requested features tested via browser automation. All key features are working. One previously reported crash (KeyboardAvoidingView in tally-sync.tsx) was fixed but the old bundle was cached. After supervisorctl restart expo, the screen loads correctly. All modals, tabs, filters, and screens verified via screenshots.

react_native_issues.issue: RESOLVED: After expo restart, KeyboardAvoidingView crash is gone. Fix was applied but old bundle was cached - a supervisorctl restart expo cleared it.

action_items: IMPORTANT: After any code fix that changes imports, always restart expo via 'sudo supervisorctl restart expo' to clear metro bundler cache - otherwise old cached bundle may still show crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: All API data is MOCKED - no real Tally connection, all fixtures are hardcoded in server.py
Metro bundler cache can persist old builds - supervisorctl restart expo needed after import changes
